description: Every modeling row must have a unique as_of_date-ticker key.
Dates, tickers and sectors must be valid.
Technical market information must not extend beyond as_of_date.
has_target must contain only 0 or 1.
Modeling rows need complete targets and inference rows must contain none.
sample_role must agree with target availability.
The target must begin strictly after as_of_date.
The target end must not precede the target start.
Every modeling target must use the configured 21-session horizon.
All companies on the same rebalance date must share target timing metadata.
The rebalance calendar must contain one row per as_of_date.
Every panel date must exist in the rebalance calendar.
Panel target availability must match the rebalance calendar.
Stored modeling targets must preserve the calendar timing exactly.
Predictor columns must not contain targets or future-return metadata.
Model features may be missing, but they must never be infinite.
TTM snapshots must be unique by date, ticker and metric.
All TTM components must have been available by as_of_date.
The latest accounting quarter must not end after as_of_date.
Every TTM observation must contain exactly four quarters.
Every TTM date-ticker key must belong to the master modeling panel.
